1.Speedy Peeling: Effortlessly peel grapes, cherry tomatoes, and other small fruits with this powerful 50W electric grape peeling machine. Save time and energy, optimal for busy kitchens or meal prep.
2.Rechargeable Portable Design: Features a built-in rechargeable battery (USB charging), the portable wireless fast fruit peeler is lightweight and convenient for home, restaurant, or catering use.
3.Safe and Easy to Use: Equipped with a non-slip base and smooth peeling mechanism, the automatic fruit peeler machine protects the flesh of the fruit. Simple one-touch operation, safe for anyone to use.

5.Easy to Clean, Sturdy: Skin remover tool with dishwasher-safe detachable parts for easy cleaning. Made with food-grade materials, ensuring durability for daily use.
